highlights.reason_zh: 公开代码把 agent 探索编译成可重复自动化，适合直接做一天验证；医疗效果与生产规模仍为厂商自报。
highlights.reason_en: Public code compiles agent discovery into repeatable automation and supports a one-day trial; healthcare outcomes and production scale remain vendor-reported.

highlights.reason_zh: Qwen4-Max 从会下线的预览变成有价格的正式 API，直接改变长上下文 agent 的成本与采购判断。
highlights.reason_en: Qwen4-Max moves from an expiring preview to a priced production API, changing long-context agent cost and procurement decisions.

highlights.reason_zh: HY4 Flash 把托管多模态价格压得很低，但开放权重尚未交付，性能也只有厂商数据。
highlights.reason_en: HY4 Flash pushes hosted multimodal pricing unusually low, but open weights have not shipped and performance evidence is vendor-only.

highlights.reason_zh: OpenAI 为获批组织提供免费专用图像筛查 API；没有公开性能数据，输出不能当概率或法律认定。
highlights.reason_en: OpenAI offers approved organizations a free dedicated image-screening API; no public performance data exists and outputs are not probabilities or legal findings.

highlights.reason_zh: GitHub 可一次为 20 个仓库启动 AI Scan，降低组织推广成本；功能仍是 public preview。
highlights.reason_en: GitHub can start AI Scan across 20 repositories at once, reducing rollout friction; the bulk control remains a public preview.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功并读完，并主动检索模型、开发工具、开源、小团队、研究、基础设施、政策及重大综合新闻。三项主要性能或部署数据仍为发布方自报；多份 11 月 16 日公告只有日期精度，不能声称通过逐小时筛选。arXiv 周一批次在截止前尚未出现。本轮没有重大综合新闻补充。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were read, with active discovery across models, developer tools, open source, small teams, research, infrastructure, policy and major general news. Three major performance or deployment claims remain publisher-reported; several November 16 announcements expose date-only precision and cannot be claimed as hour-filtered. The Monday arXiv batch had not appeared by cutoff. No major general-news supplement was selected.
